cues.text: You choose what changes, and which devices receive it. Your wallet acts as a secure approval app. It confirms your permission, without sharing your private key.

clips.title: From publishing to a device result

cues.text: Sui saves your approval on a shared network. Walrus stores your software files for the period you choose. Private releases are encrypted, with access limited to authorized devices.
The SuiFleet client on each device checks for approved updates on its configured schedule. Connections start from the device, so you do not need to open an incoming connection.
When an update is available, the device downloads it from Walrus and verifies that it matches the approved release. A device that reconnects can catch up while the update remains available.
SuiFleet then runs your configured installer. Your platform handles installation, any reboot, and recovery. This lets you use the update process that suits your devices.
See which installations succeeded and which failed. Device health is reported separately. If an update fails, review the available diagnostics before trying again.
